text:
maria: Hey team, FYI after a dependency bump our Node/TS app started getting 404s when calling client.summarize(). Worked yesterday.

maria: Stack trace from server: 
```
Error: Request failed with status code 404
    at createError (/app/node_modules/axios/lib/core/createError.js:16:15)
    at settle (/app/node_modules/axios/lib/core/settle.js:17:12)
    at IncomingMessage.handleStreamEnd (/app/node_modules/axios/lib/adapters/http.js:260:11)
```

maria: Minimal repro (TS):
```
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await client.summarize({ prompt: 'summarize this article' });
```

maria: npm ls shows `@redwood/inference@0.18.1` — we pinned for other reasons. No obvious network or auth errors. Any thoughts? :confused:

tyler: thanks for the report, maria. quick Qs: did you also upgrade any environment images or the runtime? and can you paste the exact 404 response body (if any)?

maria: 404 body is just `{ "error": "route_not_found", "message": "unknown endpoint: summarize" }`. No infra changes, just package upgrades.

alex: @maria can you run `npm ls @redwood/inference` and `node -e "console.log(process.version)"`? also which API host (hosted vs dedicated vs private)?

maria: output:
```
+-- @redwood/inference@0.18.1
node v18.16.0
HOSTED
```

sophia: hunch: we recently shipped a small SDK surface change where the old `summarize` convenience helper was folded into a `summaries` namespace to support more options (batching/metadata). older client 0.18.x will try to call `/v1/summarize` which the API dropped in favor of `/v1/summaries.create`. If you're pinned to 0.18.1 you'll see route_not_found.

tyler: that matches the error. we had a rollout note but customers with pinned deps might miss it. quick workaround: call the HTTP REST endpoint directly or shim client calls. e.g. curl: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/summaries.create \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"input": "summarize this article"}'
```

tyler: note the param rename: old SDK used `prompt` but new API expects `input` (and the SDK 0.20.x maps `client.summaries.create({ input: ... })`).

maria: ok that explains it. I can bump to 0.20.x in staging, but need a quick patch for prod where we can't upgrade right away. Any tiny shim I can drop in our service?

alex: you can monkeypatch a helper that forwards to the REST endpoint with the new route and param name. example node helper: 
```
import fetch from 'node-fetch';
export async function summarizeShim(prompt){
 const res = await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/summaries.create',{
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.RW_KEY}`, 'Content-Type':'application/json' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ input: prompt })
 });
 return res.json();
}
```

maria: thanks, that should be fine for a short window. we'll schedule an upgrade. any chance we can get a compatibility shim in the SDK patch?

sophia: SDK team is planning a 0.20.2 patch that logs a deprecation warning and exposes `client.summarize()` calling the new route for one release cycle. CI build is queued. tagging @ci-bot to track release.

ci-bot: build #472 for @redwood/inference 0.20.2 started (tests running)... :gear:

tyler: action items: 1) maria to deploy shim to prod for ~24–72h; 2) support will follow up once 0.20.2 is published so you can safely upgrade; 3) we'll add a note to release notes + status page.

maria: deploying shim now. I'll post back if anything else breaks. thanks for the quick diagnosis! :thumbsup:
